Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo learned a lot about music. Leo bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Her upbringing shaped her patience.
Last Thursday, Leo and Tom went to the temple fair. Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the moon-lit yard. The drummer set the tempo for the band.
Leo plays basketball with Tom every Thursday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. Tom is interested in singing. These grapes are sweet and juicy.
The weather was cloudy that day. Leo hopes to visit Toronto one day. Leo drinks water after doing sports.
